requested_items.objective: Measure first-pass Nangate45 physical feasibility for the complete descriptor-driven endpoint/mesh composition.

expected_result.reason: Replace additive endpoint/router composition with an aggregate placed control/fabric anchor at a matched floorplan envelope.

requested_items.acceptance_notes: Require all sixteen endpoints and routers retained, no combinational ready cycle, valid descriptor-before-release behavior, rotating full-payload observability, and a completed row or explicit bounded failure. Report harness overhead and do not claim SRAM macro, workload-activity, or HBM/DRAM closure.
